source.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished original game art asset for Doupo Living World / Battle Through the Heavens. Maintain a coherent series style in refined painterly realism, restrained ink contours, tactile gouache texture, warm stone/ivory and muted jade teal, antique gold accents. This is an original visual interpretation of novel characters, NOT a copy of any film, anime, game or celebrity likeness. No lettering, title, labels, watermark, UI or decorative frame. Clear silhouette and distinct identity. Single half-body dialogue portrait, anatomically clean hands if shown, three-quarter view, ample headroom and shoulders fully in frame. Opaque softly mottled ivory-paper background, no scenery. Natural Chinese facial proportions, subtle expression, detailed cloth rather than glossy plastic. Character-specific design below determines the individual subject. Portrait 3:4. Younger characters wear modest fully covered loose long-sleeved clothes appropriate to their stated age, in a simple natural upright pose. Subject: 萧炎·开篇. Adolescent boy, around fifteen, lean earnest face, short tied black hair, plain charcoal practice robes with a worn linen belt, a discreet old dark ring, determined eyes; no adult giant weapon or imperial costume. Character differentiation is essential: individual anatomy, hairstyle, age, costume and pose; do not repeat a stock face or pose from previous images. Painted illustration with visible fine brush texture, not a glossy 3D render. Youthful male face, strong straight thick eyebrows and a short angular jaw; dark intense eyes, no feminine makeup. Simple short tied-back hair, no elaborate bun or ornament. Front three-quarter pose with one hand by the old ring.
